### Trouble in Canaan
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/trouble-in-canaan
Passage: Judges 1:28
Points:
- Israel's failure to completely expel the Canaanites revealed an underlying lack of trust in God.
- Forcing the inhabitants into labor substituted human convenience for God's explicit commands.
- External military and political achievements masked profound spiritual disobedience.
- Faithful life and ministry must be judged by wholehearted obedience rather than outward metrics.

### The Subtle Destruction of Compromise
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/the-subtle-destruction-of-compromise-greg-laurie-daily-devotion-september-9-2015.html
Passage: Judges 1:28
Points:
- Failing to finish the conquest allowed defeated enemies to regain power and oppress Israel.
- Christians often yield large areas to God while keeping private closets locked from Him.
- Unaddressed sin acts like a tree stump that sprouts back stronger if left rooted.
- Tolerating minor compromises inevitably allows small sins to grow into major spiritual defeat.
